note: The manual's order: an opening, eleven chapters in four parts, and the reference at the back. build.mjs draws the page from this, and check.mjs holds each written chapter to it. A chapter with `file` is written; one with only `planned` is shown in its place as not written yet. `film` is its folder under docs/explainer/films, and `section` its recording, record/NN-<section>.sh.
